It should be noted that the correlation in the positions of magnetic centers is not taken into account in our model. This corresponds to the so-called Bragg-Williams approximation in the theory of disordered media.

The Bohr radius of the Mn 0Ga center is about 1 nm. The Mn concentration corresponding to such an average distance between acceptors is 10 21 cm−3. This corresponds to a manganese content of about 5%.
This means that the real CD cannot be estimated with any degree of accuracy and, in turn, the quantitative comparison of theory and experiment is impossible.
